Title: Manager, HEOR Diabetes
Description: Tu impacto empieza aquí Como HEOR Manager, convertirás evidencia científica y del mundo real en insights claros que ayudan a crear valor el area de diabetes, en el equipo de Clinical Data Science and Evidence (CDSE) en los Estados Unidos. No se trata solo de responder solicitudes: serás dueño de entregables clave, desde revisiones de literatura hasta Data on File. Tu trabajo acerca la evidencia a quienes deciden y apoya el uso adecuado de tratamientos para personas que viven con diabetes. Capacidad para comprender, sintetizar y comunicar evidencia científica y económica de forma clara. Experiencia en project management, seguimiento de entregables y manejo de timelines. Comodidad trabajando en un modelo de soporte global, equilibrando ejecución operativa e iniciativa propia. Experiencia con modelos farmacoeconómicos o evidencia aplicada a estrategias de valor y acceso. Formación en Economía, Actuaría o Ciencias de la Salud, o un PhD relacionado con HEOR, Epidemiología, Salud Pública o farmacoeconomía. Experiencia o conocimiento en diabetes. Lo que harás Tu misión: que la evidencia correcta llegue a tiempo, en el formato correcto, a quien la necesita. Para lograrlo, vas a: Realizar revisiones de literatura, sistemáticas y rápidas, y sintetizar evidencia científica y del mundo real. Traducir hallazgos técnicos en insights, presentaciones, read-outs y materiales claros para Market Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial y Managed Markets. Impulsar entregables de Real-World Evidence, HEOR y farmacoeconomía, incluido el desarrollo y la actualización de Data on File, herramientas de modelaje y análisis rápidos de data. Identificar brechas de evidencia y proponer acciones concretas para cerrarlas. Mantener vigentes repositorios, trackers, slide libraries, resúmenes de estudios, materiales de congresos y timelines de publicaciones. Coordinar prioridades y tiempos con equipos internos, stakeholders de Estados Unidos, consultores y proveedores, y sumarte a proyectos especiales donde puedas generar más impacto. Con quién trabajarás Te unirás al equipo de Clinical Data Science & Evidence en GBS México, que genera, sintetiza y comunica evidencia del mundo real para la operación de Estados Unidos. Trabajarás de cerca con stakeholders de Estados Unidos en Market Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial y Managed Markets, además de colegas internos, consultores y proveedores externos. Es un rol de colaboración diaria entre países: tú aportas claridad sobre prioridades y tiempos, y ellos ganan foco para avanzar en lo estratégico. Lo que puedes esperar aquí Aquí tu voz cuenta. Tendrás espacio para proponer, tomar decisiones sobre tus entregables y crecer más allá de la ejecución, con exposición directa a stakeholders de Estados Unidos y a distintas funciones. Desarrollarás nuevas habilidades en el trabajo y junto a tus colegas, en un entorno que te apoya y confía en ti para dar lo mejor. Formarás parte de un equipo global de casi 70,000 personas que trabaja con un mismo propósito: ayudar a más personas a vivir vidas más saludables. Empieza ahora La evidencia no puede esperar. Tú tampoco. Tu impacto empieza hoy: si quieres convertir datos en decisiones que acerquen tratamientos para la diabetes a más personas, postúlate como HEOR Manager. Revisamos las postulaciones de forma continua, así que te invitamos a aplicar cuanto antes.

Title: Director, Commercial Operations
Description: Overview About the Role & Team IDC is seeking a Director, Commercial Operations to provide senior-level insight and operating leadership across some of our most important commercial priorities. This person will have a broad view across the Commercial portfolio and work directly with senior leaders to understand performance, identify where we need to go deeper, and shape the decisions and actions that follow. They will not simply respond to questions or report results. We expect them to recognize the questions we should be asking, develop a point of view grounded in the data and business context, and bring forward clear recommendations. Much of the work will cross functions and organizational boundaries. The Director will bring senior leaders and teams together around complex issues, challenge assumptions when needed, create clarity around what needs to happen next, and help drive action on priorities that matter to the business. What You’ll Do Commercial Performance & Portfolio Analysis Own analysis of key Commercial KPIs, trends, variances, and performance drivers across the portfolio. Develop an integrated view across regions, segments, teams, and strategic priorities to identify where performance is changing, where risk is emerging, and where deeper attention is warranted. Bring together data from multiple sources, reconcile inconsistencies, and investigate results that do not immediately make sense. Look beyond headline numbers to understand underlying drivers, patterns, risks, and opportunities. Connect signals across different parts of the business to identify broader implications that may not be visible when each area is viewed independently. Strategic Insights & Decision Support Turn complex data and operational information into clear insights, implications, and recommended actions for senior leadership. Take broad or ambiguous commercial questions, determine what needs to be understood, and structure the analysis required to get there. Develop a point of view grounded in evidence and challenge assumptions when the data points somewhere else. Advise leadership on critical commercial priorities by clarifying what is working, what is not, what has changed, and what decisions or trade-offs may be required. Create executive reporting, business reviews, analyses, and presentations that make important issues easier to understand and act on. Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence Partner with senior leaders and teams across Commercial, Revenue Operations, Finance, Marketing, IT, and other functions on priorities that span organizational boundaries. Bring together the right information, perspectives, and expertise to create a shared understanding of complex issues. Build strong working relationships across departments and work through conflicting information, unclear ownership, or different points of view. Create clarity around the inputs, decisions, actions, and deliverables needed from each contributor. Hold owners accountable for commitments and follow through when required information, decisions, or actions are missing. Surface unresolved issues early and bring the right leaders together when progress requires broader coordination or intervention. Turning Insight Into Action Work with senior leaders and business owners to translate findings into clear actions and expected outcomes. Evaluate whether actions taken are actually changing the result and identify when a different response is needed. Recognize when an issue requires deeper analysis, a different approach, or senior leadership attention. Help leadership focus on the issues that matter most and make sure important findings do not stop at the report, dashboard, or presentation. Reporting & Process Improvement Continuously improve the reporting, metrics, dashboards, and analytical approaches used to understand Commercial performance and strategic priorities. Identify reporting and operational processes that are manual, fragmented, inconsistent, or harder than they need to be. Work with partner teams to improve data quality, standardization, automation, and recurring workflows. Build practical, scalable tools and processes that give leadership better visibility into the business and make it easier to identify issues and act on them. What Success Looks Like We are looking for someone who is analytical, commercially minded, and naturally curious. When something changes, they want to understand why. When the numbers do not add up, they keep digging until they do. They also need the judgment and credibility to operate with senior leaders across functions. This person should be comfortable with challenging assumptions, pushing for clarity, holding others accountable, and forming a point of view even when the answer is not obvious. Above all, we want someone senior leadership can trust to understand the business, identify what matters, and help shape the actions we take on our most important commercial priorities. What You Bring 8–12+ years of experience in Commercial Operations, Business Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy, Transformation, Analytics, or a related field. Strong analytical skills and experience working with business performance data, KPIs, trends, and operational metrics. Demonstrated ability to move from data to insight, understand broader business implications, and develop clear recommendations. Experience advising senior leaders on high-priority business questions, strategic initiatives, or performance issues. Experience developing executive reporting, business reviews, analyses, and presentations for senior leadership. Strong ability to structure ambiguous questions, develop hypotheses, and work through complex problems independently. Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large or complex data sets. Strong PowerPoint skills and the ability to turn detailed information into clear, concise executive communication. Demonstrated ability to partner with and influence senior stakeholders across multiple functions without direct authority. Experience improving reporting, workflows, or operating processes through better design, standardization, tools, or automation. Familiarity with Salesforce and business intelligence or reporting platforms is preferred. Strong communication, judgment, organization, and follow-through. Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and operate with a high degree of independence. Why This Role Stands Out At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions. Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand. Equal Opportunity Employer IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify. If this role relocates to a different country, the salary range will be updated to reflect that country's range, rather than a currency conversion of the original range.

Description: Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of. Who We Are… When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next… From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive. Your New Role… The SENIOR FINANCIAL ANALYST – THEATRICAL REPORTING & CONTROLS will be responsible for providing timely and accurate forecasting, reporting and analysis for Warner Bros. Discovery Studios, working with business finance counterparts to gather inputs and understand drivers. You will develop deep competencies in this area, providing business and finance stakeholders the required information for decision making. Your Role Accountabilities… •    Preparation of Domestic and International Results of Operations for Senior Management. •    Research and Resolve accounting issues supporting other teams within the finance function such as Controllership, ITC, and other Home Office teams. •    Prepare the quarterly calculation of foreign exchange impact on revenue and gross margin by territory and currency. •    Assist in the preparation of the Territory information sheets, including gathering the multiple data points for Feature Film and Local Production business. •    Coordinate month end activities with Controllership teams. •    Responsible for master data requests including, but not limited to, general ledger accounts, profit & costs centers, location codes, and MPM attributes. •    Design, build, and continuously update interactive Power BI dashboards to monitor operational metrics, key performance indicators, and overall workflow efficiency. •    Prepare monthly reporting packages for 3rd Parties where WBD distributes their IP, this includes report generation, review against ultimates and distribution to the 3rd Party. •    Support the participations team with participation statement validation against financial ledger. •    Responsible for ensuring users have correct access for multiple business systems, this includes periodic review to ensure authorized personnel have access to these systems. •    Build strong relationships with business partner FP&A teams to enable the flow of information and knowledge sharing. •    Support development of systems, tools, and processes to facilitate efficient and accurate forecasting and analysis. •    Drive process simplification initiatives. Collaborate across boundaries and share best practices with other FP&A teams. •    Other Activities as Determined by Management. Qualifications & Experience… ●    At least 4 years’ experience in forecasting & analysis. ●    Strong English verbal and written communication skills (must have). ●    Strong proficiency in excel and other data analysis techniques.  Demonstrated experience in financial modelling. ●    Critical thinker and strong problem solver with excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to frame issues, articulate findings and present optimal solutions. ●    Proven ability to build confidence and trust with department members and external business partners. ●    Experience working accurately and efficiently with high volumes of data under strict deadlines. Preferred Qualifications… •    Solid understanding of entertainment business preferred (Theatrical/Games/Consumer Products/Home Entertainment and/or Global Themed Experiences Industry). •    Strong Accounting knowledge preferred. •    Proficiency in Power BI (including DAX, data modeling, and automated report refreshes) to transform complex data sets into clear, actionable visual insights. •    Essbase, SAP, Tableau experience preferred. II.   MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Please explain in specific detail the main responsibilities of this position.  Explain not only what is done, by why it is done (and/or for whom).  Also include examples and note tools or equipment used to accomplish the duty.      % time spent •    Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual forecast process for the Home Entertainment segment, including revenue accruals review and forecasting, licensed revenue analysis and ongoing market trends. Review and forecast costs for new and ongoing projects and analyze trends where needed. Demonstrate and maintain high standards of accountability to deliver superior quality financial information on timely basis to Home Entertainment FP&A. •    Reconcile actuals vs prior forecast/budget/prior year and provide variance explanations. Conduct Ad Hoc analysis as needed. Participate in assigned Home Entertainment meetings such as, but not limited to:  Monthly Close / Accruals / Forecast / Quarterly Business Revenue / Budget. •    Ensure effective communication with local stakeholders. Demonstrate solid communication skills to build and foster business relationships with business stakeholders. •    Support development of systems, tools, and processes to facilitate efficient and accurate analysis. Seek for constant process and routines improvements in the duties and task under its scope. Prepare ad-hoc analysis for Home Entertainment FP&A Finance and Business Stakeholders.
